title: Scanned symbol after head repositioning
statement: Let $r_1$ and $r_2$ be distinct work-tape registers. For any configuration $c$, state $s$, and integer $k$, form the configuration with state $s$, the same tapes and input head as $c$, and both register-head positions set to $k$. The symbol then scanned on register $r_1$ is the content of register $r_1$ in $c$ at cell $k$.
